claim_ceiling: Narrow analytical robustness only: under frozen synthetic 32-task corpus (5 blog-read-post, 15 shop/admin/pm, 12 other) and tiktoken-measured registry costs (LITERAL 19691, PARAM 18624, diff 1067 = 3168 prompt savings -2101 resolution overhead, completion 64/64 equal), the 1067-token workflow diff is unaffected by uniform (systematic) completion bias (infinite threshold; 33.3 tokens/task is differential threshold) and survives 96.1% of independent Normal(est,0.5*est) bootstrap samples (100% if shared-draw or raw-scale). This falsifies the fragile hypothesis (break-even <2 tokens/task and survival <30% per frozen F1/F2) within this analytical model. No inference justified that 5.42% token savings is economically meaningful, that COLD success >=90%, that C-PRODUCT-ECON is validated, or that 5.42% generalizes to real SPIDER registry or real LLM outputs. Maximum justified product claim remains option C executed (browser/verification constant offset) with thin 5.42% margin pending real LLM measurement (option A).
